(2) The person reveals a red, flat, tongue-shaped ceramic object with a hole, which serves as a straw, and demonstrates how it rests inside the mouth of the cup. (3) A woman with freckles and a light blue turtleneck appears, placing the ceramic tongue straw in her mouth as if drinking, looking directly into the lens with a slightly shocked expression. (4) A bald man with earrings enters the frame, attempting to drink from the cup in the same way while the woman watches him with a hand to her forehead in amusement or mock embarrassment. (5) The woman stands in a bright kitchen-style room, holding the red tongue piece and laughing as she speaks to the camera about the oddity of the product design.
